commands.name: zsh-syntax
commands.run: zsh -n zsh/claude-account.zsh

commands.name: py-compile-hooks
commands.run: python3 -m py_compile claude/hooks/account_guard.py claude/hooks/herdr_orch_core.py

commands.name: wrapper-self-contained
commands.run: ! awk '/^function claude\(\)/,/^}/' zsh/claude-account.zsh | sed 's/#.*//' | grep -q '_claude_config_dir'

commands.name: wrapper-rung-in-both-functions
commands.run: awk '/^function claude\(\)/,/^}/' zsh/claude-account.zsh | sed 's/#.*//' | grep -qF 'rev-parse --git-common-dir' && awk '/^function _claude_config_dir\(\)/,/^}/' zsh/claude-account.zsh | sed 's/#.*//' | grep -qF 'rev-parse --git-common-dir'

commands.name: wrapper-routes-linked-worktrees
commands.run: unset CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR; set -e; T=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT; T=$(cd "$T" && pwd -P); H="$T/home"; mkdir -p "$H/Git/work" "$H/elsewhere" "$T/bin"; export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1; for r in "$H/Git/work/wrepo" "$H/elsewhere/prepo"; do git -c init.defaultBranch=main init -q "$r"; git -C "$r" -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@x commit -q --allow-empty -m base; done; git -C "$H/Git/work/wrepo" worktree add -q "$H/.herdr/worktrees/wrepo/wt" -b wt; git -C "$H/elsewhere/prepo" worktree add -q "$H/.herdr/worktrees/prepo/wt" -b wt; mkdir -p "$H/.herdr/worktrees/wrepo/wt/sub"; printf '#!/bin/sh\nprintf "%%s" "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR-UNSET}" > "$RECORD"\n' > "$T/bin/claude"; chmod +x "$T/bin/claude"; ZSH=$(command -v zsh); run() { : > "$T/rec"; RECORD="$T/rec" HOME="$H" PATH="$T/bin:$PATH" "$ZSH" -c "cd '$1' && source '$PWD/zsh/claude-account.zsh' && $2" 2>"$T/err"; cat "$T/rec"; }; [ "$(run "$H/.herdr/worktrees/wrepo/wt" claude)" = "$H/.claude-work" ]; [ "$(run "$H/.herdr/worktrees/wrepo/wt/sub" claude)" = "$H/.claude-work" ]; [ "$(run "$H/.herdr/worktrees/prepo/wt" claude)" = "$H/.claude" ]; [ "$(run "$H/.herdr/worktrees/wrepo/wt" "claude --personal")" = "$H/.claude" ]; [ "$(run "$H/.herdr/worktrees/wrepo/wt" "CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$H/custom claude")" = "$H/custom" ]; [ "$(run "$H/.herdr/worktrees/wrepo/wt" "unfunction _claude_config_dir; unset CLAUDE_WORK_TREE CLAUDE_WORK_CONFIG_DIR; claude")" = "$H/.claude-work" ]; [ "$(run "$H/elsewhere" claude)" = "$H/.claude" ]; [ ! -s "$T/err" ]

commands.name: wrapper-claude-account-labels-linked-worktrees
commands.run: unset CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR; set -e; T=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT; T=$(cd "$T" && pwd -P); H="$T/home"; mkdir -p "$H/Git/work" "$H/elsewhere" "$T/bin"; export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1; for r in "$H/Git/work/wrepo" "$H/elsewhere/prepo"; do git -c init.defaultBranch=main init -q "$r"; git -C "$r" -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@x commit -q --allow-empty -m base; done; git -C "$H/Git/work/wrepo" worktree add -q "$H/.herdr/worktrees/wrepo/wt" -b wt; git -C "$H/elsewhere/prepo" worktree add -q "$H/.herdr/worktrees/prepo/wt" -b wt; mkdir -p "$H/.herdr/worktrees/wrepo/wt/sub"; printf '#!/bin/sh\nprintf "%%s" "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR-UNSET}" > "$RECORD"\n' > "$T/bin/claude"; chmod +x "$T/bin/claude"; ZSH=$(command -v zsh); run() { : > "$T/rec"; RECORD="$T/rec" HOME="$H" PATH="$T/bin:$PATH" "$ZSH" -c "cd '$1' && source '$PWD/zsh/claude-account.zsh' && $2" 2>"$T/err"; cat "$T/rec"; }; lab() { HOME="$H" PATH="$T/bin:$PATH" "$ZSH" -c "cd '$1' && source '$PWD/zsh/claude-account.zsh' && claude-account" 2>/dev/null; }; case "$(lab "$H/.herdr/worktrees/wrepo/wt")" in work*) ;; *) exit 1;; esac; case "$(lab "$H/.herdr/worktrees/prepo/wt")" in personal*) ;; *) exit 1;; esac

commands.name: wrapper-degrades-without-git
commands.run: unset CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR; set -e; T=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT; T=$(cd "$T" && pwd -P); H="$T/home"; mkdir -p "$H/Git/work" "$H/elsewhere" "$T/bin"; export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1; for r in "$H/Git/work/wrepo" "$H/elsewhere/prepo"; do git -c init.defaultBranch=main init -q "$r"; git -C "$r" -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@x commit -q --allow-empty -m base; done; git -C "$H/Git/work/wrepo" worktree add -q "$H/.herdr/worktrees/wrepo/wt" -b wt; git -C "$H/elsewhere/prepo" worktree add -q "$H/.herdr/worktrees/prepo/wt" -b wt; mkdir -p "$H/.herdr/worktrees/wrepo/wt/sub"; printf '#!/bin/sh\nprintf "%%s" "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR-UNSET}" > "$RECORD"\n' > "$T/bin/claude"; chmod +x "$T/bin/claude"; ZSH=$(command -v zsh); run() { : > "$T/rec"; RECORD="$T/rec" HOME="$H" PATH="$T/bin:$PATH" "$ZSH" -c "cd '$1' && source '$PWD/zsh/claude-account.zsh' && $2" 2>"$T/err"; cat "$T/rec"; }; : > "$T/rec"; RECORD="$T/rec" HOME="$H" PATH="$T/bin" "$ZSH" -c "cd '$H/.herdr/worktrees/wrepo/wt' && source '$PWD/zsh/claude-account.zsh' && claude" 2>"$T/err"; [ "$(cat "$T/rec")" = "$H/.claude" ]; [ ! -s "$T/err" ]

commands.name: wrapper-suite-covers-linked-worktrees
commands.run: grep -qF 'git worktree add' zsh/claude-account.test.sh && grep -qF 'LINKED_WORK' zsh/claude-account.test.sh && grep -qF 'LINKED_PERSONAL' zsh/claude-account.test.sh && grep -qF 'GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null' zsh/claude-account.test.sh

commands.name: wrapper-suite
commands.run: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=/nonexistent/inherited-cfg sh zsh/claude-account.test.sh

commands.name: skill-defines-cfg
commands.run: grep -qxF 'CFG="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}"' claude/skills/herdr-orchestration/SKILL.md && grep -qF "printf '%s' \"\$CFG\" | grep -qE '^/[A-Za-z0-9_./+:@-]+\$'" claude/skills/herdr-orchestration/SKILL.md

commands.name: skill-launch-lines-carry-cfg
commands.run: ! grep -F 'pane run <pane_id> "' claude/skills/herdr-orchestration/SKILL.md | grep -vF 'pane run <pane_id> "CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$CFG ' | grep -q . && [ "$(grep -cF 'pane run <pane_id> "CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$CFG ' claude/skills/herdr-orchestration/SKILL.md)" -ge 3 ] && ! grep -qF -- '-> `claude --model' claude/skills/herdr-orchestration/SKILL.md && [ "$(grep -cF -- '-> `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$CFG claude --model' claude/skills/herdr-orchestration/SKILL.md)" -ge 2 ] && grep -qF 'CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$CFG python3 $CORE run-mech' claude/skills/herdr-orchestration/SKILL.md

commands.name: contract-suite-fixtures-carry-cfg
commands.run: grep -qF 'CFG="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}"' claude/hooks/herdr-orch-contract.test.sh && grep -qF 'CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$CFG claude --model' claude/hooks/herdr-orch-contract.test.sh && grep -qF 'CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$CFG $CMD' claude/hooks/herdr-orch-contract.test.sh && grep -qF 'every pane run line carries CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=' claude/hooks/herdr-orch-contract.test.sh && ! grep -qF 'pane run "$PID" "claude' claude/hooks/herdr-orch-contract.test.sh && ! grep -qF 'pane run "$PID" "$CMD"' claude/hooks/herdr-orch-contract.test.sh && ! grep -qF 'pane run "$PID" "python3' claude/hooks/herdr-orch-contract.test.sh && grep -qF 'mech worker and its state root follow the pinned config dir' claude/hooks/herdr-orch-contract.test.sh && grep -qF 'interactive launch payload replayed through the wrapper hands claude the pinned dir' claude/hooks/herdr-orch-contract.test.sh && grep -qF 'launch config dir rule accepts the fixture dir and rejects relative and unsafe values' claude/hooks/herdr-orch-contract.test.sh

commands.name: contract-suite
commands.run: sh claude/hooks/herdr-orch-contract.test.sh

commands.name: guard-account-aware-linked-worktrees
commands.run: set -e; T=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT; H="$T/home"; mkdir -p "$H/.claude" "$H/.claude-work" "$H/Git/work" "$H/Git/personal"; printf '{"oauthAccount":{"accountUuid":"work-uuid"}}' > "$H/.claude-work/.claude.json"; printf '{"oauthAccount":{"accountUuid":"personal-uuid"}}' > "$H/.claude.json"; export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1; for r in "$H/Git/work/wrepo" "$H/Git/personal/prepo"; do git -c init.defaultBranch=main init -q "$r"; git -C "$r" -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@x commit -q --allow-empty -m base; done; git -C "$H/Git/work/wrepo" worktree add -q "$H/.herdr/worktrees/wrepo/wt" -b wt; git -C "$H/Git/personal/prepo" worktree add -q "$H/.herdr/worktrees/prepo/wt" -b wt; g() { printf '{"cwd":"%s"}' "$2" | env -u CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR HOME="$H" CLAUDE_WORK_TREE="$H/Git/work" CLAUDE_WORK_CONFIG_DIR="$H/.claude-work" ${1:+CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR="$1"} python3 claude/hooks/account_guard.py 2>/dev/null; }; ! g "$H/.claude-work" "$H/.herdr/worktrees/wrepo/wt" | grep -q account_guard; g "" "$H/.herdr/worktrees/wrepo/wt" | grep -q account_guard; g "$H/.claude-work" "$H/.herdr/worktrees/prepo/wt" | grep -q account_guard; ! g "" "$H/.herdr/worktrees/prepo/wt" | grep -q account_guard

commands.name: guard-path-fallback-linked-worktrees
commands.run: set -e; T=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT; H="$T/home"; mkdir -p "$H/.claude" "$H/Git/work"; export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1; git -c init.defaultBranch=main init -q "$H/Git/work/wrepo"; git -C "$H/Git/work/wrepo" -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@x commit -q --allow-empty -m base; git -C "$H/Git/work/wrepo" worktree add -q "$H/.herdr/worktrees/wrepo/wt" -b wt; g() { printf '{"cwd":"%s"}' "$2" | env -u CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR HOME="$H" CLAUDE_WORK_TREE="$H/Git/work" CLAUDE_WORK_CONFIG_DIR="$H/.claude-work" ${1:+CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR="$1"} python3 claude/hooks/account_guard.py 2>/dev/null; }; g "" "$H/.herdr/worktrees/wrepo/wt" | grep -q account_guard; ! g "$H/.claude-work" "$H/.herdr/worktrees/wrepo/wt" | grep -q account_guard

commands.name: guard-degrades-without-git
commands.run:
set -e; T=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT; H="$T/home"; mkdir -p "$H/.claude" "$H/Git/work" "$T/nogit" "$T/slowgit" "$T/badgit"; export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1; git -c init.defaultBranch=main init -q "$H/Git/work/wrepo"; git -C "$H/Git/work/wrepo" -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@x commit -q --allow-empty -m base; git -C "$H/Git/work/wrepo" worktree add -q "$H/.herdr/worktrees/wrepo/wt" -b wt; printf '#!/bin/sh
sleep 5
' > "$T/slowgit/git"; printf '#!/bin/sh
printf "%%s\n" "$HOME/Git/work/wrepo/.git" extra
' > "$T/badgit/git"; chmod +x "$T/slowgit/git" "$T/badgit/git"; PY=$(command -v python3); for gp in "$T/nogit" "$T/slowgit:$PATH" "$T/badgit:$PATH"; do t0=$(date +%s); out=$(printf '{"cwd":"%s"}' "$H/.herdr/worktrees/wrepo/wt" | env -u CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR HOME="$H" PATH="$gp" CLAUDE_WORK_TREE="$H/Git/work" CLAUDE_WORK_CONFIG_DIR="$H/.claude-work" "$PY" claude/hooks/account_guard.py 2>/dev/null); t1=$(date +%s); [ $((t1 - t0)) -le 3 ]; ! printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q account_guard; done

commands.name: guard-suite-covers-linked-worktrees
commands.run: grep -qF 'guard: linked worktree' claude/hooks/claude-hooks.test.sh && grep -qF 'worktree add' claude/hooks/claude-hooks.test.sh && grep -qF 'slowgit' claude/hooks/claude-hooks.test.sh && grep -qF 'nogit' claude/hooks/claude-hooks.test.sh && grep -qF 'badgit' claude/hooks/claude-hooks.test.sh && grep -qF 'intree cwd with slowgit' claude/hooks/claude-hooks.test.sh

commands.name: docs-mention-linked-worktree
commands.run: for f in CLAUDE.md README.md .claude/skills/dotfiles-run-and-operate/SKILL.md; do grep -qi 'linked worktree' "$f" && grep -qF 'CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$CFG' "$f" || exit 1; done; grep -qi 'linked worktree' zsh/claude-account.zsh

commands.name: planning-artifacts-untracked
commands.run: ! git ls-files docs/specs docs/plans docs/superpowers | grep -q .

commands.name: public-safety-suite
commands.run: sh git/hooks/public-safety.test.sh
